method: Distinct dated locality IDs are taken from data/coverage-audit.json regionalRanking. Periods union locality IDs in data/coverage-audit.json matrix. Geography follows that audit, including state clipping and editorial rectangles. Fiji, Tonga and Samoa are one region; its two antimeridian components are unioned before counting. The gaps were selected by coverage counts and post-arrival chronology, editorially prioritized among eligible candidates, with bounded subregion exceptions disclosed. Counts measure available local evidence, which can include broad historical reference points, and do not measure population or continuity.
